profiles.title: NT2 course readiness
profiles.purpose: Prepare for the learner's actual course outcomes.
official_format_summary: Reading, listening, writing and speaking; local course rules govern the exam.
original_practice_tasks: Check a personal four-skill readiness checklist against the course contract.
profiles.format_note: There is no single universal exam blueprint for every Belgian course provider. Do not import one provider's pass rule into this app.
profiles.permitted_tools_note: Follow the current official instructions for the chosen profile.

profiles.title: Certifying Dutch A1/A2 readiness
official_format_summary: Atlas: written reading/writing and oral listening/speaking parts.
Brussels: reading/listening first; writing/speaking on a separate day.
original_practice_tasks: Read a notice, understand a message and respond with the requested details.
profiles.format_note: Test organisation and required skills depend on the holder and purpose. Check current official rules before booking.
profiles.permitted_tools_note: Follow the current official instructions for the chosen profile.

profiles.title: Certifying Dutch B1/B2 readiness
profiles.purpose: Practise independent public and professional communication.
official_format_summary: Written and oral components; their order varies by holder.
original_practice_tasks: Explain a problem and support a practical solution using supplied information.
profiles.format_note: Acceptance of a certificate must be checked with the receiving institution; Atlas does not offer C1.
profiles.permitted_tools_note: Follow the current official instructions for the chosen profile.

profiles.title: CNaVT INFO

profiles.title: ITNA B2
official_format_summary: Computer: language in use, reading and listening.
Speaking: presentation and argumentation after a sufficient computer result.
original_practice_tasks: Work through original language-in-use items; prepare a presentation and defend a position.
profiles.format_note: The official site provides question-type examples, not a dedicated preparatory textbook. App scores are not ITNA results.
profiles.permitted_tools_note: Follow the current official instructions for the chosen profile.

profiles.title: ITNA C1
official_format_summary: Computer and speaking components; qualifying results lead to an extra C1 writing task on another day.
original_practice_tasks: Produce and revise an original source-based argument for a specified audience.
profiles.format_note: This is a follow-on procedure with official eligibility rules, not a standalone four-part C1 exam.
profiles.permitted_tools_note: The official C1 writing task permits Word spelling/grammar checking; do not impose a blanket no-tools imitation.

profiles.title: BOSA professional language tests
profiles.purpose: Professional communication for a specific certificate or role.
official_format_summary: Possible reading, listening, oral and written modules; certificate-specific rules choose the modules and level.
original_practice_tasks: Use an original workplace brief to prepare a clear explanation and written response.
profiles.format_note: No generic level or pass score is asserted. The legal article and exact certificate must be selected before a timed format is implemented.
profiles.permitted_tools_note: Follow the current official instructions for the chosen profile.
